headline: Subshell 0.92: thread colours, sorted search and feeds that keep your place
highlights: This update signs you out once: sign in and set up your Client ID or RedReader again, then add your widgets and pinned shortcuts back.
Settings › Comments › Thread colours: branch lines by depth or in one colour, each top-level comment in its own card. Off by default, works with Guide lines.
Sort search results and the posts on a profile, with a time range for Top.
Optional: Settings › Feeds & content › Resume where you left off opens Home and communities at your place after the app has been closed.
Find in thread has an OP chip that steps through the post author's comments.
Search no longer asks Google Trends: the empty search page shows only your history and Reddit's suggestions.
Fixed: video sound going on after Back from search or a profile, the keyboard coming back in search, links to a comment not landing on it.
Help & about now has the licence, the source code, every library's licence and what Reddit's January 2027 API change means.
